title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.01393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. translated_title: 大语言模型辅助的本体网络构建中类型化语义链接发现
translated_abstract: 在本体之间构建类型化、有依据的语义链接，对于实现异构和跨学科知识领域之间的互操作性至关重要。然而，人工整理此类链接难以规模化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个用于本体网络构建的端到端框架，该框架可自动发现和生成领域内及跨领域的关系。我们的方法结合了经过领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入用于密集上下文表示、基于聚类的预过滤以减少候选搜索空间，以及通过迭代提示工程由GPT-4o驱动的关系生成，以产生语义丰富且可解释的链接。将该流程应用于ReproduceMeON——一个涵盖机器学习、显微成像、计算科学和实验工作流的33个本体组成的网络——可将约80万个原始概念对缩减为9.5万个高质量候选对。
tldr: 该论文提出一个结合领域适配DistilBERT嵌入、聚类预过滤和GPT-4o驱动关系生成的端到端框架，用于自动发现和生成本体间类型化语义链接，在包含33个本体的网络上将约80万概念对高效缩减为9.5万高质量候选对。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end framework combining domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings, clustering-based pre-filtering, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation to automatically discover typed semantic links between ontologies, reducing approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates on a network of 33 ontologies.
